name: FloorDAO
fix_description: Same rebasing logic issue as HeavensGate (bench-140). In stake, rebase() is called between receiving input token and sending staked token. Attacker stakes right before rebase to capture reward without holding risk. Fix: calculate staked token amount based on post-rebase exchange rate.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is only a few core actions, but it requires understanding protocol-specific staking/circulating-supply accounting and how repeated stake/unstake cycles with a flash-borrowed balance extract value. It also involves Uniswap V3 flash liquidity and swap callbacks, making it more than a trivial single-pattern bug but still not a deeply complex multi-protocol attack chain.
